title: Air Fryer Chicken Breast
metaDescription: Juicy air fryer chicken breast ready in under 20 minutes — the fastest way to get tender, evenly cooked chicken without drying it out.
author: Laura Bennett
keywords: air fryer chicken breast, juicy air fryer chicken, quick chicken dinner

steps.name: Prep the chicken
steps.text: Pound the chicken breasts to an even thickness, about 3/4 inch. Rub with olive oil, then season with garlic powder, paprika, onion powder, salt and pepper.

steps.name: Preheat and arrange
steps.text: Preheat the air fryer to 375°F (190°C). Arrange the chicken in a single layer in the basket.

steps.name: Air fry
steps.text: Cook for 7 minutes, flip, then cook for another 6-7 minutes until a meat thermometer reads 165°F (74°C) in the thickest part.

steps.name: Rest and serve
steps.text: Let rest for 5 minutes before slicing.

tips.question: Why does air fryer chicken breast cook so much faster than the oven?
tips.answer: The air fryer circulates hot air at high speed in a small enclosed space, which cooks food faster than a conventional oven — the same reason it also crisps surfaces well without extra oil.

tips.question: Why pound the chicken first?
tips.answer: Even thickness matters even more in the air fryer's shorter cook time — a thick uneven breast can end up raw in the center while the thin end overcooks.

tips.question: Can I cook frozen chicken breast in the air fryer?
tips.answer: Yes, though it will take roughly 50% longer and won't season as evenly since the rub can't penetrate frozen meat — thawing first gives better results.

storyIntro: Air fryer chicken breast is the fastest reliable way I've found to get juicy chicken on a weeknight — under 20 minutes total, with the same doneness check as oven-baked (165°F on a thermometer).
The circulating hot air cooks it faster and more evenly than an oven, without drying out the outside before the inside catches up.
storyNote: Pound the chicken to an even thickness before it goes in — the air fryer's fast cook time leaves less margin for uneven thickness than a slower oven bake does.
